messages.subject: Cann't load Isotope Data
messages.body_plain:
Dear Mr./Ms.,
  After I import the data, the system doesn't report any error, but the consumerlist is always empty, what's wrong?
This is the code:
consumergrass <- loadIsotopeData(df=tp, consumer = "Grass_carp", consumersColumn = "FG",
                            b1 = "Pelagic_BL", b2 = "Benthic_BL",
                            baselineColumn = "FG",
                            group = c("ZQ","FK","TX"),
                            groupsColumn = "Location")

Thank you for your kindly help.
Dr. Xia
